A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same GCS research work, with 29 readable pages and complete Appendices A-K. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that pages 3-29 are identical; differences are confined to pages 1-2.

before.justification: v2 reports original concept-vector similarity, accuracy and hierarchy analyses across three LLMs, plus emotion-steering experiments in Table 1 and supplementary results in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the multi-model analyses, Table 1 steering scores and appendix experiments.

M1.justification: The GCS procedure, Algorithm 1 and intervention method are unchanged. Equation (1) corrects the background description of the frozen model's residual stream; it does not establish a change to the implemented architecture or proposed method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same generated datasets covering 16 hierarchical concepts and the same joyful-versus-angry movie-review steering task.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same Mean Difference and One linear comparators, with identical definitions in Appendix C. No comparator is added, removed or revised.

E3.justification: Model configurations, probing and evaluation sample counts, sampling ranges, steering strengths and GPT-4o scoring procedures remain identical in Section 4 and the appendices.

E4.justification: The sampling-distance and layerwise analyses, steering examples, and Gaussian-mean PCA comparison are unchanged, including Figures 3 and 6-10 and Appendices E-K.

E5.justification: Average-score reporting and descriptions of repeated sampling are unchanged. No run or seed information, uncertainty estimates or statistical tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Table 1, all result figures and the qualitative steering examples are identical. No numerical values, result entries, rankings or reported findings change.

T1.justification: Section 2, Equation (1), changes h + MLP(h + Att(h)) to h + Att(h) + MLP(h + Att(h)), restoring the omitted attention residual contribution. This is a localized mathematical correction consistent with the existing prose; other equations and assumptions are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about Gaussian concept subspaces, faithfulness, plausibility and steering effectiveness while maintaining fluency.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and Appendix A's limitations are identical, including dependence on generated data, the restricted plausibility evaluation and possible inaccuracies in GPT-4o judging.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, hardware descriptions, generation and evaluation prompts, and code-access information are unchanged. Embedded link targets also match.

R1.justification: Section 5, citations and the reference list are identical, preserving the same positioning relative to concept-vector, hierarchical-representation and inference-time intervention research.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 6 March 2025 to v3 dated 5 May 2025. Body prose, terminology, section ordering and appendix organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Page 2 has localized mathematical typesetting changes: Equation (1) widens and is recentered, and two vector symbols in the linear-probing definition become bold. Figures, tables, captions and all layouts on pages 3-29 are identical.

improvement.justification: v3 repairs the missing attention residual term in Section 2, Equation (1), improving mathematical correctness and consistency with the surrounding explanation. The gain is limited: the GCS method, empirical evidence, claims and appendices remain unchanged, with no substantive deterioration identified.
